statement: The shared Solver session registry refuses a live worktree's claim of a different writable Quest before replacing its existing Quest lease, preserving the original claim until an explicit release or successful non-rejected solve land; same-Quest heartbeat refresh, cross-worktree arbitration, and the explicit lease bypass retain their current behavior.

constraints.statement: After explicit declaration and before first execution, record an independent approving design-review receipt bound to the sealed declaration.
If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
